name: tour
title: Tour
description: A guided product tour: spotlighted targets, a dimmed backdrop, and positioned step popovers with next/prev/skip/finish actions and progress dots.
importSnippet:
import Tour from "@/components/ui/tour/tour.marko";
import type { TourStep } from "@/components/ui/tour/tour.marko";
usageSnippet:
static const steps = [
  { id: "welcome", type: "dialog", title: "Welcome", description: "A quick look around.", actions: [{ label: "Start", action: "next" }] },
  { id: "search", target: "#search", title: "Search", description: "Find anything here.", actions: [{ label: "Done", action: "dismiss" }] },
] satisfies TourStep[];

<Tour items=steps>
  <@trigger|props|>
    <Button ...props>Start tour</Button>
  </@trigger>
</Tour>

parts.name: trigger
parts.description: Render-prop for the tour trigger (usually a "Start tour" button).

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Whether to close the tour when the user presses the escape key

props.name: closeOnInteractOutside
props.description: Whether to close the tour when the user clicks outside the tour

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the tour. Useful for composition.

props.name: items
props.description: Steps with selector targets — the serializable way to describe a tour.

props.name: keyboardNavigation
props.description: Whether to allow keyboard navigation (right/left arrow keys to navigate between steps)

props.name: preventInteraction
props.description: Prevents interaction with the rest of the page while the tour is open

props.name: spotlightOffset
props.description: The offsets to apply to the spotlight

props.name: spotlightRadius
props.description: The radius of the spotlight clip path

props.name: stepId
props.description: The id of the currently highlighted step

events.name: onFocusOutside
events.description: Function called when the focus is moved outside the component

events.name: onInteractOutside
events.description: Function called when an interaction happens outside the component

events.name: onPointerDownOutside
events.description: Function called when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

events.name: onStatusChange
events.description: Callback when the tour is opened or closed

events.name: onStepChange
events.description: Callback when the highlighted step changes

events.name: statusChange
events.description: Sugar for onStatusChange — receives the plain status.

events.name: stepIdChange
events.description: Sugar for onStepChange — receives the plain step id.

import Tour from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/tour/tour.marko"; import type { TourStep } from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/tour/tour.marko"; import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko"; static const STEPS = [ { id: "welcome", title: "Welcome aboard", description: "This short tour walks you through the main areas of the dashboard.", type: "dialog", actions: [ { label: "Skip", action: "skip" }, { label: "Start", action: "next" }, ], }, { id: "search", title: "Search everything", description: "Find projects, people and settings from a single input.", target: "#tour-search", placement: "bottom", arrow: true, actions: [ { label: "Back", action: "prev" }, { label: "Next", action: "next" }, ], }, { id: "notifications", title: "Stay in the loop", description: "Unread activity shows up here as soon as it happens.", target: "#tour-notifications", placement: "bottom-end", arrow: true, actions: [ { label: "Back", action: "prev" }, { label: "Next", action: "next" }, ], }, { id: "publish", title: "Ship it", description: "When you are happy with your changes, publish them here.", target: "#tour-publish", placement: "top", arrow: true, actions: [ { label: "Back", action: "prev" }, { label: "Finish", action: "dismiss" }, ], }, ] satisfies TourStep[];

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source:
import Tour from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/tour/tour.marko"; import type { TourStep } from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/tour/tour.marko"; import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko"; static const STEPS = [ { id: "controlled-one", title: "First", description: "The parent owns the current step id.", target: "#tour-controlled-target", placement: "bottom", arrow: true, actions: [{ label: "Next", action: "next" }], }, { id: "controlled-two", title: "Second", description: "Driven entirely from parent state.", target: "#tour-controlled-target", placement: "top", arrow: true, actions: [ { label: "Back", action: "prev" }, { label: "Done", action: "dismiss" }, ], }, ] satisfies TourStep[];
Controlled target

stepId: ${currentStepId ?? "none"} · status: ${tourStatus}

{ currentStepId = stepId; } statusChange=(status) => { tourStatus = status; } > <@trigger|props|>
examples.description: Pair `stepId` with `stepIdChange` (or Marko's bind shorthand `stepId:=state`) to drive the current step from parent state, and `statusChange` to observe the tour's lifecycle.

fields.name: target
fields.description: CSS selector of the element this step highlights. Omit for a modal step.
